contexts.text: Ye call me Master and Lord; and ye say rightly; for so I am () = that He was Jehovah God. He is there called Lord as to good, and Master as to truth. AC 9167:2.

When the Lord had been glorified... He became Divine good, from which the Divine truth then proceeds. Hence it is that after His resurrection the disciples did not call Him Master, as before; but the Lord. Illustrated.
Hence it is that by... God, King, and Master, is meant the Lord as to Divine truth. Illustrated.
A state of intelligence commences with a man, when he no longer thinks from a master, but from himself; which does not take place until the interiors are being opened towards Heaven. Explained.
(The infants are then) transferred into another Heaven, where they are instructed by masters.
Those who in childhood have supposed the things which they have heard from their masters to be true...
In the natural sense it is allowable (to call another master); but not in the spiritual.
Not... to be decorated with the laurel of tutorship.
(The boys) said to their master... Master, let us not stay in this place... and then the master instructed them...
While their nurses and masters sit in the porches of the houses...
I said (to the satan), As you are come from a Society where there are tutorships, tell me what you believe... about God.
He replied, I am a laurelled master; and then I said. Master, ...
When the external man serves the internal... he is then as his master and as his lord (); for they act as one...
When a man is in a spiritual idea, he will think of the Lord alone as Father and Master...
I. Let a man... learn from a master, and from preachings, the dogmas of his own religion.
